dimensions.note: Denoiser's actual composition and aesthetic are its own house style and are explicitly excluded from imitation, per the catalog note and per SUENGJ-VISUAL-TASTE-CALIBRATION.md's own airy/warm-neutral target.

dimensions.note: This reference is a documentation note about a multi-surface consumption architecture, not itself a rendered infographic — it is not authoritative for body-infographic density or line weight.

weaknesses: No evidence about palette, line weight, or density — this reference speaks to structure, not surface language.
